steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease two 8x4-inch loaf pans.
Beat eggs in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until frothy. Slowly add sugar while continually beating. Stir in oil and vanilla; continue beating until mixture is thick. Stir in zucchini.

Mix flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt, and baking powder together in a separate bowl; pour into zucchini mixture and stir until just combined. Mix in walnuts. Divide batter between the prepared loaf pans.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of each loaf comes out clean, about 1 hour. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then loosen the edges with a knife, remove the loaves, and let cool completely on a wire rack.

raw_recipe.headline: Caley's Classic Zucchini Bread
raw_recipe.description: This zucchini bread recipe makes two moist, flavorful loaves packed with freshly grated squash, warm cinnamon, crunchy walnuts, and sweet vanilla.
raw_recipe.name: Caley's Classic Zucchini Bread

review.reviewBody: Love this bread. It is simple and delicious! I did make a few changes. I used 1 1/2c of sugar instead of the 2 cups, used 1/2c oil and 1/2c applesauce, used wheat flour instead of all purpose and since I didn't have enough zucchini on hand I used 1c zucchini and 1c shredded carrots. Yum!!

Everyone loved this one, especially the kiddos!
I used 1/2 C of Oil and 1/2 C of Applesauce instead of the whole cup of Oil, a little healthier that way and very moist.
I used mini loaf pans, baked them approximately 35 minutes (when knive poked into center comes out almost clean).
As long as my garden keeps giving me 3 zucchini’s a day (use normal size, not the huge ones) I will be making this bread to freeze for later.
Oh, I didn’t add the nuts!

I loved this recipe! It was delicious. The only thing I changed was the sugar. Instead of white sugar, I did brown sugar. Instead of 2 cups Of sugar, I did 1 cup of sugar. For us It made it a bit less sweeter, without compromising the flavor. Thank you so much for this recipe it truly was moist and delicious. God bless America!

I modified the recipe by using olive oil instead of vegetable oil, whole wheat brown flour instead of regular flour, and added a bit less sugar. (My small contribution to trying to eat healthier.) I also used muffin tins and baked them for 45 min., and they came out great with a crunchy top. Definitely, spray and flour the tin. Very yummy.

Delicious and simple. I made them as mini-muffins, baked them for 15 minutes at 350. I also made one mini loaf with some leftover batter and baked that for about 37 minutes. I added some chocolate chips to the mini muffins for my son and he scarfed the down. Great recipe!

Such a Good recipe for our family and friends. I substitute second cup of zucchini with grated carrots, half the sugar I used coconut sugar, vanilla was substituted with Mexican vanilla, I add extra zucchini or carrots if I have left overs and add extra flour to handle the moisture 1/2-1/2 cup Delicious

I cut down the sugar to 1 and /1/2 cups -- I used less cinnamon- 1 tsp> then added 1 cup each of choc chips and chopped walnuts . My recipe made 2 small and 1 9 x9 loaf which I baked about 40 to 45 min-- took mini loafs out first then bigger loaf about 8 min later -- tasted great! oh and I added about 2 t. pure vanilla.
 I think this is one of those easy recipe to change and fool around with- to one's preference and it still comes out great!

I did. I put 1 C brown sugar 
1C white sugar

It smells delicious. I’m sure it will taste delicious tooo.

Changes:. 1cup of sugar instead of 2
2 cups of bread flour

This bread was crispy on the outside and moist on the inside.

I decided to make this recipe today with zucchini my husband picked from our garden. This bread is delicious, and easy to make. I did make some adjustments though. I cut back on the sugar, adding only 1 cup, cut back on the vegetable oil, adding 3/4 cup. I added 1 cup of chopped walnuts, which was just enough. I froze one loaf to enjoy another time and we are keeping the other loaf out to have this weekend. My husband can't wait for me to make more!
